dataSource.select:
SELECT IU.IMPR_NBR IMPR_NBR, IU.ACT_DT ACT_DT, IU.ACT_TYPE ACT_TYPE, DECODE( IU.ACT_TYPE, 'U', 'تعديل السجل', 'D', 'حذف السجل', 'I', 'إضافة سجل', IU.ACT_TYPE ) ACT_TYPEM, L_CT.CITY_ARB_NAME ADD_CITY_ARB_NAME, IU.ARBC_IMPR_NAME ARBC_IMPR_NAME, IU.BUS_ID BUS_ID, IU.BUS_ID_BRNCH BUS_ID_BRNCH, L_BIT.BUS_ID_TYPE_NAME BUS_ID_TYPE_NAME, IU.ENG_IMPR_NAME ENG_IMPR_NAME, IU.HQ_IMPR_NBR HQ_IMPR_NBR, L_CT2.CITY_ARB_NAME ID_CITY_ARB_NAME, IU.IMPR_EXPR_TYPE IMPR_EXPR_TYPE, CG.RV_MEANING IMPR_EXPR_TYPEM, L_IT1.IMPR_TYPE_NAME IMPR_TYPE_NAME, L_USR.USR_ANAME L_USR_USR_ANAME, IU.USR_ID USR_ID, IU.BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT, IU.EMAIL EMAIL, IU.IMPR_CNTCT_NAME IMPR_CNTCT_NAME, IU.IMPR_FAX_NBR IMPR_FAX_NBR, IU.IMPR_POB_NBR IMPR_POB_NBR, IU.IMPR_TELEX_NBR IMPR_TELEX_NBR, IU.IMPR_TEL_NBR IMPR_TEL_NBR, IU.IMPR_ZIP_CD IMPR_ZIP_CD, L_IMP.ARBC_IMPR_NAME PARENT_IMPR_NAME, L_IT1.IMPR_TYPE_CD L_IT1_IMPR_TYPE_CD, L_BIT.BUS_ID_TYPE_CD L_BIT_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD, L_ITIDT.IMPR_TYPE_CD L_ITIDT_IMPR_TYPE_CD, L_ITIDT.BUS_ID_TYPE_CD L_ITIDT_BUS_ID_TYPE_CD, L_IMP.PORT_CD L_IMP_PORT_CD, L_IMP.IMPR_NBR L_IMP_IMPR_NBR, L_CT2.CITY_CD L_CT2_CITY_CD, L_CT2.CTRY_CD L_CT2_CTRY_CD, L_CT.CITY_CD L_CT_CITY_CD, L_CT.CTRY_CD L_CT_CTRY_CD, L_CTRY.CTRY_CD L_CTRY_CTRY_CD, L_CTRY.CRTY_ARBC_NAME L_CTRY_CRTY_ARBC_NAME, L_USR.USER_ID L_USR_USER_ID, L_USR.PORT_CD L_USR_PORT_CD, IU.CITY_CODE CITY_CODE, IU.CTRY_CD CTRY_CD, IU.ADD_CTRY_CD ADD_CTRY_CD, IU.CITY_CODE_OF_ID CITY_CODE_OF_ID, IU.CTRY_CD_OF_ID CTRY_CD_OF_ID, IU.BUS_ID_TYPE_CD BUS_ID_TYPE_CD, IU.IMPR_TYPE_CD IMPR_TYPE_CD, IU.PORT_CD PORT_CD, IU.IMPR_NAME_STD IMPR_NAME_STD, IU.IMPR_DATA_SRCE IMPR_DATA_SRCE, IU.IMPD_STMT_NBR IMPD_STMT_NBR, IU.LST_TRAN_DT LST_TRAN_DT, IU.IMPR_NBR_PARENT IMPR_NBR_PARENT FROM CG_REF_CODES CG, COUNTRIES L_CTRY, CITIES L_CT, SC_USERS L_USR, BUS_ID_TYPES L_BIT, IMPR_TYPES L_IT1, IMPR_TYPE_ID_TYPES L_ITIDT, CITIES L_CT2, IMPORTERS L_IMP, IMPR_UPDTS IU WHERE IU.PORT_CD = L_IMP.PORT_CD AND IU.IMPR_NBR = L_IMP.IMPR_NBR AND IU.CTRY_CD_OF_ID = L_CT2.CTRY_CD (+) AND IU.CITY_CODE_OF_ID = L_CT2.CITY_CD (+) AND IU.IMPR_TYPE_CD = L_ITIDT.IMPR_TYPE_CD AND IU.BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = L_ITIDT.BUS_ID_TYPE_CD AND L_ITIDT.IMPR_TYPE_CD = L_IT1.IMPR_TYPE_CD AND L_ITIDT.BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = L_BIT.BUS_ID_TYPE_CD AND IU.PORT_CD = L_USR.PORT_CD AND IU.USR_ID = L_USR.USER_ID AND IU.ADD_CTRY_CD = L_CT.CTRY_CD AND IU.CITY_CODE = L_CT.CITY_CD AND IU.CTRY_CD = L_CTRY.CTRY_CD AND CG.RV_DOMAIN(+) = 'ALLOWED EXPORT' AND CG.RV_LOW_VALUE(+) = IU.IMPR_EXPR_TYPE AND (IU.ACT_DT BETWEEN (:START_DT) AND (:END_DT) OR (:START_DT IS NULL AND :END_DT IS NULL)) AND (L_IMP.PORT_CD = :P_CURR_PORT_CD OR :P_CURR_PORT_CD IS NULL)
&P_IMPR_NBR
